messages.author: 304b9f87e6ec0e4a
messages.subject: Custom CoveredArea
parts:
Hi all, 

Thank you for this wonderful package and for providing this space for queries. Apologies in advance for the relatively novice question. 

I'm currently working through an analysis that is based on slightly winding transects (i.e. not perfectly straight). I've accounted for these bends with regards to distance form the trail -- now I'm working on the best way to update the "CoveredArea" currently produced by the ds function. 

The difference between CoveredArea for a straight transect and for my winding transects are very close, but I thought I'd see if there is a method for using this custom calculation -- effectively overwriting the automatic CoverdArea calculation (based on straight transect) which I believe is made when the ds function.

Being able to insert this custom CoveredArea would simply save time by not having to recalculate the estimates that are typically generated automatically in the ds function. Fingers crossed that this can be easily achieved (otherwise I'll happily calculate everything again). 

Thanks in advance for your support! 

Best, 
Michael

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Custom CoveredArea
parts:
Michael

Afraid there is no facility to drop in an alternative covered area into the portion of code that scales up density in the covered region to abundance in the study area.  It is not a request we have previously received; consequently is not on our priority list.  However we make a note of suggestions we receive on the list when evaluating future enhancements.  Thanks for your interest.
